lecturer.criterion: Eight everyday situations are available with descriptive titles
Every conversation turn renders its specific intention and exactly three distinct replies

observed.prompt: The barista asks: «Che cosa prende?» You want one coffee. What do you say?
The barista asks: «Qui o da portare via?» (Here or to take away?) You want to drink at the café.
You finish your coffee and want to pay. Ask for the bill.
At the ticket desk, you need one ticket to Bologna. Choose your request.
options: Due biglietti per Bologna, per favore.
Un biglietto per Bologna, per favore.
Un biglietto per Firenze, per favore.

observed.prompt: The clerk asks: «A che ora vuole partire?» (What time do you want to leave?) You want 09:00.
You know the departure time. Now ask which platform the train leaves from.
options: Da quale binario parte il treno?
A che ora parte il treno?

observed.prompt: The seller asks: «Che cosa prende?» You need one kilogram of apples.
options: Due chili di mele, per favore.
Un chilo di pere, per favore.
Un chilo di mele, per favore.

observed.prompt: You also see bread, but there is no price label. Ask how much the bread costs.
The seller asks: «Altro?» (Anything else?) You have everything you need. Decline politely.
A classmate asks: «Come ti chiami?» Your name in this scene is Luca.
Your classmate asks: «Di dove sei?» You are from Bristol.
Your classmate asks: «Quanti anni hai?» Your age in this scene is 27.
You need to find the station. Ask a stranger where it is.
The person says: «La stazione è a destra.» Confirm the direction you hear.
The person asks: «Va a piedi o in autobus?» (Are you walking or taking the bus?) You are walking.
You call a restaurant to reserve a table. Choose the request that says this.
The restaurant asks: «Per quante persone?» There are two of you.
The restaurant asks: «A che ora?» You want your table at 20:00.
A friend asks: «A che ora ti svegli?» In this routine, you wake up at seven.
Your friend asks: «A che ora inizi a lavorare?» In this routine, work starts at nine.
Your friend asks: «Quando studi italiano?» In this routine, you study every day.
A friend asks: «Vieni al cinema stasera?» You are free and want to accept.
Your friend asks: «A che ora ci vediamo?» (What time shall we meet?) You want 19:00.
For dinner, your friend asks: «Ti piace la pasta?» You like pasta. Give a clear yes about pasta.
options: No, non mi piace la pasta.

sceneObservations.prompt: The barista asks: «Che cosa prende?» You want one coffee. What do you say?
sceneObservations.hint: Check both the drink and the quantity. Per favore makes a request polite.
sceneObservations.feedback:

Un caffè, per favore.

Un caffè means one coffee. Caffè is masculine, so use un. A short order with per favore is natural.
